title: NPCore: Progression
summary: Understand how contacts change as missions, stock, services, and persistence come online.

blocks.title: Early Contacts
blocks.body: Early NPCs are best used for orientation, simple trades, and safe services. Learn their role before depending on rare stock or mission-gated offers.

blocks.title: Mission Pressure
blocks.body: When MissionCore is present, a trade can require a mission state. Locked offers are usually telling you to advance the route, not spam the contact.

blocks.title: Persistent Value
blocks.body: With DataCore, stock, cooldowns, and conversion records can persist instead of living only in memory. That makes repeated visits more predictable on long-running servers.

blocks.title: Upgrade Check
blocks.body: Do not raise the risk until the current upgrade tier works without emergency improvising.
